evidence.source: 漢語多功能字庫 (Chinese University of Hong Kong)
evidence.field: 晚: graph analysis and historical senses
evidence.text: The entry explicitly analyzes 晚 as 日 semantic plus 免 phonetic and gives its original sense as sunset/dusk. It cites 說文「莫也。从日，免聲」 and 段玉裁’s explanation of 莫 as the sun nearing darkness. It separately cites uses of 晚 for night in a Southern Liang poem, for late in 墨子, for a later period/successor in 淮南子, and for old age in 史記. The cited examples illustrate these senses but do not independently establish when each first arose.
evidence.title: 漢語多功能字庫 — 晚

evidence.source: Ministry of Education, Taiwan, Dictionary of Chinese Character Variants
evidence.field: 晚: Shuowen analysis, meanings, and historical dictionary records
evidence.text: The entry quotes 說文「莫也。从日，免聲」 and 無遠切. It lists dusk/sunset, night, late, successor/later, old age, nearing an end, and junior self-reference, with cited examples from 楚辭, Tang poetry, 漢書, 淮南子, 史記, and later works. Its historical-form list links to transmitted 說文 and later dictionary facsimiles; it does not establish a pre-seal graphic sequence.
evidence.title: A01801 晚 — Ministry of Education Dictionary of Chinese Character Variants

evidence.source: 和若琳, 汉语“夜晚”名称的共时分布和历时演变
evidence.field: period-level lexical survey of names for night
evidence.text: The article says its survey covers pre-Qin through Qing materials and uses Peking University CCL and BCC corpora. It reports that 晚 generally did not express the time-of-day/night sense in its sampled pre-Qin-to-Eastern-Han materials, where 莫夜 and other terms occur; it reports 晚 used for night in Six Dynasties material, with “晚” compounds becoming more prominent in Tang-Song and later periods. This is a survey result, not proof of the first occurrence of each sense.
evidence.title: 汉语“夜晚”名称的共时分布和历时演变

evidence.text: The official database describes itself as a corpus of oracle-bone character heads and forms and reports 2,548 character heads and 24,701 forms as of 2026-09-27. The search interface was inspected, but no 晚-specific result or form record was returned through the available page. This does not establish that no oracle-bone form exists.

evidence.field: File description, original image link, and licensing
evidence.text: The exact file page identifies 夜-seal.svg as a digitally created Shuowen seal-script-style depiction of 夜. It provides an original file link and states public-domain status for the SVG representation; the description identifies Sinica Database and other reference sites as sources. This is a modern redraw of another character, not an ancient artifact image and not evidence for 晚’s form history, so it is not selected as an asset.

search_audit.outcome: Inspected the CUHK and Taiwan Ministry dictionary entries, the Xiaoxuetang oracle-bone database interface, Unihan field documentation, and a Commons exact file description page. Both direct Unihan character records failed to load; the exact Commons original-file link failed with a cache miss.

search_audit.query: site:xiaoxue.iis.sinica.edu.tw 晚 字形演變 小學堂 晚; 晚 字形 小篆 晚 sunset seal script Wikimedia Commons 晚-seal.svg; Baxter Sagart 2014 晚 免 *m[o][r] *mr[o][r] phonetic series; 晚 六朝 以前 用例 夜晚 词汇史 晚 上古 汉语 语料
search_audit.outcome: Inspected the Xiaoxuetang form-evolution database landing page, the full accessible historical survey, and the Commons file page. No 晚-specific Xiaoxuetang record or applicable licensed glyph image was verified; the survey supplies period-level lexical claims and examples.

gaps: No inspected external source supplied a dated oracle-bone, bronze, or bamboo-slip specimen of 晚, or a chronological graphic sequence before the small-seal form. The inspected Xiaoxuetang page was the database interface rather than a character-specific record; missing results here are not proof of absence.

The source dictionaries state 日 + 免声, but no independent historical pronunciation comparison for 免 and 晚 was verified from an external primary-reading table. The local packet’s Baxter–Sagart rows give 晚 MC mjonX / OC *m[o][r]ʔ and 免 MC mjenX / OC *mr[o][r]ʔ; those exact local notations were provided in the packet and are not external evidence. Current local Unihan kMandarin rows are 晚=wǎn and 免=miǎn, but official character-specific Unicode pages were inaccessible.

The earliest occurrence of 晚 with dusk/sunset sense was not established. CUHK gives classical examples for multiple senses, while the corpus survey reports a sampled period-level pattern for its night-time sense; neither alone fixes first attestations or proves every semantic transition.

No evidence was found supporting the dossier mnemonic that 免 means “avoiding” the sun. Dictionary sources instead explicitly assign 免 a phonetic role. No whole-graph loan or object-name borrowing claim was substantiated.

No usable 晚 historical glyph image with verified identity, provenance, and reuse rights was established. The inspected Commons candidate represents 夜, is a modern redraw, and is irrelevant to 晚; the CUHK and Taiwan seal-image links were opened but returned cache misses. No image is proposed.

limitations.text: No selected glyph asset: the accessible Xiaoxuetang interface did not yield a 晚-specific form record; CUHK and Ministry-linked seal images were inaccessible to the web tool; and the inspected Commons file is a redraw of 夜 rather than 晚. The dictionary text supports the seal-script description but no direct image URL with verified access and suitable provenance was established.
